proposals.title: Custodial funds: reconcile money held for other beneficiaries
proposals.gap: The existing 102-guide coverage includes governmental-fund and government-wide bridges but no worked fiduciary additions/deductions reconciliation.
proposals.plan: An independently invented multi-beneficiary receipt/disbursement register, receivable and payable bridge, with custodial classification stipulated and no state code/threshold generalization.

proposals.title: Existing-resource debt defeasance: separate the fund payment from the liability exit
proposals.gap: The existing lease and financing guides do not model a qualifying cash-funded defeasance with carrying adjustments.
proposals.plan: An original economic-resources gain/loss bridge against a separately displayed governmental-fund expenditure, using stipulated qualifying trust evidence and no new refunding debt.

proposals.title: Asset retirement obligations: connect current outlays with deferred-resource expense
proposals.gap: The existing capital-disposal guide does not measure a legal retirement obligation or deferred-outflow rollforward.
proposals.plan: An original current-cost component register and later price-change bridge for an already qualifying economic-resources obligation, avoiding the source probability/tank example.

proposals.title: Foreclosed property held for sale: reconcile carrying value and holding activity
proposals.gap: The prior asset-sale guide concerns sales recognition; no existing guide tracks held-for-sale property and holding expenses.
proposals.plan: An original two-property period-close register with independently supplied initial bases, separate holding cash flows and bounded valuation changes; no replication of the source acquisition/decline/recovery example.

proposals.title: Goodwill testing: sequence other asset losses before applying the goodwill cap
proposals.gap: The existing impairment workbook routes models but does not provide this ordered, capped reporting-unit calculation.
proposals.plan: An original multi-asset reporting-unit reconciliation with other losses already independently measured, then a bounded goodwill comparison and sensitivity; exclude private-company elections and tax effects.

proposals.title: Agreed-upon procedures and examinations: match the report to the user’s question
proposals.gap: The prior service-selection guide covers audit, review, compilation and preparation; it does not work through an attestation procedure-results engagement versus an examination.
proposals.plan: An original operational compliance question, measurable criteria, a deliberately bounded results register and alternative assurance scope. Do not draft official report wording, infer population assurance or reproduce state checklists.
